title: West Kelowna Half Day Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Grat!
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in West Kelowna
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Westside Wine Trail in West Kelowna is a perfect mix of history, charm, and award-winning wines! Home to some of the oldest vineyards in the Okanagan, it also features quirky boutique wineries that will wow you with every sip. This half-day “Sip Disturber” tour treats you to tastings at four top-notch wineries with up to 20 unique wines to sample, all while soaking in stunning vineyard views and Okanagan Lake. Just a short drive from downtown Kelowna, this trail guarantees a deliciously fun wine adventure! On this approximately 4 hour tour, enjoy VIP pick up and drop off, all tasting fees, and tour guide gratuity is included!
